description: A3 amendment 1: PBTI-SH and the A3 comparators on the eight V3 fractional-factorial cells with equivocation high (runs 2, 3, 4, 5, 8, 9, 14, 15 at 10%), of which runs 3, 4, 8 and 15 also have suppressed runs high (the condition in which B5 retained fewer forgeries than PBTI in V3). 120 s production, 180 s drain. Fresh seeds 21-40. Added after the A3 pilot (seed 101) showed that the preregistered joint grid, which lacks the factorial's other delivery factors, produced almost no retained forgeries.
